launches.title: Framewise Health - Videos for every patient
launches.tagline: We turn medical records into personalized explainer videos in seconds
launches.body:
Hello! We’re [Tane](https://www.linkedin.com/in/tanekim/) and [David](https://www.linkedin.com/in/david-cui-589a20228/), co-founders of [Framewise Health](https://framewisehealth.com).

# **TL;DR**

**Framewise Health turns medical records into personalized videos that walk patients through onboarding, adherence, and recovery.** The data we collect lets hospitals and clinics spend less time chasing patients and more time caring for them.

**_Ask_:** Can you introduce us to specialty clinic owners, hospital service-line chiefs, patient experience VPs, or pharma medical affairs leads? Contact us at [tane@framewisehealth.com](mailto:tane@framewisehealth.com)

Launch video: <https://youtu.be/ri6U0W8frFU>

# **The Problem**

Nearly 9 out of 10 people in the U.S. lack proficient health literacy.

Yet, our healthcare system has relied on educating patients using complex paper packets for decades, leaving us with static, generic solutions that cause three problems:

* Ineffective learning
* Low medical adherence
* Poor patient outcomes

Preventable medication-related harm costs the U.S. over $500 billion every year.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=101156&key=user_uploads/3115980/d644d1d2-1da6-4aec-8a1e-13dae6d1a309)

Until now, there was no cost-effective way to create personalized education material for patients. But with the latest video generation models, this no longer has to be the case.

# **Our Solution**

Every video is generated from the patient's medical records, institutional protocols, and national drug data. Every patient interaction tells you what they understood, per patient, per topic, in real time. 

That comprehension data feeds back to the care team, so they know which patients are on track and which need a callback.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=101156&key=user_uploads/3115980/06903869-3f1e-4802-b6de-f36937a2b3b4)

# **How can you help?**

If you can introduce us to any of the following, we’d be grateful.

* Hospitals (service-line chiefs, CMIOs, virtual health program leads, VPs of patient experience)
* Pharma (medical affairs leads on adherence, patient services VPs, clinical education directors)
* Private clinics (practice owners in procedure-heavy specialties)

Please contact us at [tane@framewisehealth.com](mailto:tane@framewisehealth.com)

# **Who we are**

Tane and David met during Brown University’s freshman orientation.

Tane (CEO) dropped out of Brown’s BS/MD program and saw 500+ patient interactions at over a dozen institutions. 

David (CTO) researched computer vision at Brown and was an engineering intern at a YC voice AI company (Freya S25).
